text: Figure 5.14: Modeling of DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordClientPortMapping for the usage on the AUTOSAR adaptive platform [constr_10684] Restriction for the applicability of DiagnosticExtended- DataRecordClientPortMapping Imposition time: IT_DiagDes ⌈If an RPortPrototype is referenced by a DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord- ClientPortMapping, then the RPortPrototype shall be typed by a Diagnos- ticExtendedDataRecordInterface.⌋ There is no other use case for a RPortPrototype that is typed by a Diagnos- ticExtendedDataRecordInterface, apart from becoming the target of a Diag- nosticExtendedDataRecordClientPortMapping. This restriction is formulated in [constr_10685].
